subject: Exec QBR + technical demo — aligning schedules and exec sponsor
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@finco.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Exec QBR + technical demo — aligning schedules and exec sponsor

Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. We like to schedule the technical demo for your engineering team and simultaneously lock in an Exec-level QBR with your VP/C-level sponsor so both tracks run in parallel. Goal: demo + architecture deep-dive with engineers, then a short QBR (30m) with execs to confirm success criteria and next-steps (procurement / commitments).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm who on your side will be the exec sponsor for the QBR? (VP/CIO/CTO preferred)
- Please pick preferred 1-2 windows next week for the demo + QBR (we can run demo at T-0 and QBR immediately after, or demo day + QBR the following day).

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-09 09:00-12:00 (demo anytime in this window; QBR 11:30)
- Wed 2026-03-10 13:00-16:00 (demo 13:00; QBR 15:30)

I like to include our SE, Dylan Brooks (cc), and I also like to loop in our VP of Sales, Laura Bennett, if we expect any exec-level discussion on roadmap/contract.

Agenda we propose: 1) 60-75m technical demo & architecture, 2) 30m exec QBR (success metrics + procurement timeline). I will attach a short QBR agenda once we confirm.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0112
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@finco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finco.com>, procurement@finco.com, sec-request@finco.com
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR + technical demo — aligning schedules and exec sponsor

Thanks Jordan.

Samantha will coordinate procurement, looping in procurement@finco.com. For the exec sponsor, I will check with our CTO (Michael Park) and confirm by EOD Monday. On the security side, our InfoSec team (sec-request@finco.com) will want a high-level SOC2 summary and any notes about data residency/pseudonymization ahead of the demo.

From an engineering perspective, the following two windows work for our team (EST):
- Tue 2026-03-09 12:00-15:00 EST (which covers your 09:00-12:00 PST)
- Wed 2026-03-10 16:00-18:00 EST (13:00-15:00 PST)

We prefer to run the demo first (60-75m) with our engineers, then the 30m QBR for execs immediately after. If your VP can join the tail of the demo for 10-15m prep that be helpful.

Also: procurement requested a preliminary SOW + ballpark pricing so they can flag any procurement constraints — Samantha, can you advise what format you like that in?

—Alex
Alex Nguyen
Senior Staff Engineer, Integrations | FinCo
alex.nguyen@finco.com
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@finco.com>
Cc: procurement@finco.com, sec-request@finco.com
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR + technical demo — aligning schedules and exec sponsor

Jordan / Alex,

Procurement here. A short SOW summary (1-2 pages) plus an indicative pricing sheet is sufficient for initial review. PDF or Google Doc is fine. We will need your standard T&Cs and any data handling clauses called out (SOC2 attestation, data retention). If you can share those before the demo, it speeds our internal review.

Also: FYI our fiscal approver will be out the week of Mar 16, so if procurement is needed for execution, sooner is better from our side.

Samantha Ortiz
Procurement Manager | FinCo
samantha.ortiz@finco.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@finco.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finco.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR + technical demo — aligning schedules and exec sponsor

Hi all,

Great — thanks for the clarity. I like to lock the Tue 2026-03-09 09:30 PST slot for the demo and QBR follow immediately at 11:15 PST (we keep the QBR to 30 minutes). I also propose a 20m pre-brief at 09:00 PST for your engineering leads + our SE (Dylan) so we can tailor the demo to the right architecture topics.

Laura, I appreciate it if you could sponsor the QBR on our side (short 30m with your VP if possible). I attach a one-page QBR agenda and the SOW/high-level pricing; procurement requested a PDF so attaching QBR_Agenda.pdf and a short SOW summary (SOW_Summary.pdf). If you want to tweak the pricing language, please advise and I update before sending to procurement.

Calendar link (provisional): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finco-qbr-20260309
Doc link (SOW): https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BexampleSOW

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@finco.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finco.com>, procurement@finco.com, sec-request@finco.com
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec QBR + technical demo — aligning schedules and exec sponsor

Jordan / team — happy to sponsor on our side and join the 11:15 PST QBR.

Quick notes:
- I will join the QBR for the first 20 minutes. If the customer exec wants to run longer, we can extend, but keep initial ask to 30m.
- Dylan, please prepare a 3-slide architecture / risk slide for the pre-brief (09:00 PST) that calls out: latency expectations, data isolation patterns, and rollout options (Dedicated vs Private).
- Security: I like to send our SOC2 summary and the contract terms doc to your sec and procurement contacts prior to the demo. Attaching SOC2_Summary.pdf and Contract_Terms.pdf for the thread.

Alex / Samantha: Confirmed 09:00 PST pre-brief, 09:30 demo start, 11:15 QBR on Tue 2026-03-09. I appreciate a one-line confirmation from your exec sponsor when they accept.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP of Sales | Redwood Inference
